item.text:
I found the failure path, but did not edit project source or tests: my assigned role in this run is fault localization only. I recorded the findings in [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).

- [PassBridgeFactory.ts](/app/packages/pass/lib/bridge/PassBridgeFactory.ts:51) creates a vault inside `getDefault`. The required contract separates lookup from creation: `getDefault` should return the oldest active vault or `undefined`, and `createDefaultVault` should create one only when needed. [types.ts](/app/packages/pass/lib/bridge/types.ts:21) needs the matching signatures.
- [PassAliasesProvider.tsx](/app/packages/components/components/drawer/views/SecurityCenter/PassAliases/PassAliasesProvider.tsx:144) assumes initialization always returns a vault and immediately fetches its aliases. Its `getAliasOptions` throws when no vault exists (line 136), so the creation form closes after its options request fails. The provider logic belongs in the required `usePassAliasesProviderSetup.ts` hook, with lookup during initialization and creation when options are requested.
- [HasNoAliases.tsx](/app/packages/components/components/drawer/views/SecurityCenter/PassAliases/HasNoAliases.tsx:23) contains explanatory copy but no explicit “No aliases” message. [AliasesList.tsx](/app/packages/components/components/drawer/views/SecurityCenter/PassAliases/AliasesList.tsx:30) deliberately displays only three items, which may explain the reported partial list.

The existing [PassAliases.test.tsx](/app/packages/components/components/drawer/views/SecurityCenter/PassAliases/PassAliases.test.tsx:64) mocks the context, so it does not establish whether initialization, no-vault handling, or cache updates work. The fix should cover vault present and absent, modal options after vault creation, fresh aliases after submission, and cached aliases on reopening.
